problem_statement: The ring buffer type must provide non-destructive read operations. tsrb_peek_one() must return the oldest byte still available in the ring buffer without removing it, returning -1 when the ring buffer is empty; repeated calls return the same byte until a remove operation takes it, and a byte whose value is 0xff must be returned as 0xff rather than as the -1 error value. tsrb_peek() must copy into a destination buffer as many bytes as are available, up to a maximum number of bytes passed in, without removing them, return the number of bytes copied (0 when the ring buffer is empty), and leave the ring buffer's contents and available byte count unchanged.
